rules.statement: An undertaking by a party to an action to abide by the ruling of the Court is of no avail, unless the opposite party is himself prepared to acquiesce in the decision.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the first place, an undertaking of this nature, to have a binding effect, should, in my opinion, be given in a more formal and solemn manner than in the shape of a casual answer to a question put by the Court in the course of the examination of a party as a witness. In this connection I may observe that the Commissioner in his judgment says that in spite of the defendant's undertaking his counsel urged the plea of prescription, and that plea the Commissioner has in effect upheld."
